cells.title: Rename the rendered agent shells and add bee-elder for the advisor kind
cells.action: Rename the five agent templates with git mv (bee-build→bee-worker, bee-design→bee-comb, bee-gather→bee-forager, bee-extract→bee-scout, bee-review→bee-guard) and update each file's `name:` and every self-reference in its body. Add packages/bee/agents/bee-elder.md.tmpl modelled on bee-review.md.tmpl: read-only tools (Read, Grep, Glob), description 'Advisor seat for the bee Delegation contract — a session-class consult, a hat seat, or a blind lane; reached only through bee dispatch prepare', body = the advisor contract (read-only, digest with recommendation/confidence/falsifier, no state writes, no decisions). In onboard/templates.rs rename every row of AGENT_ROLES_BY_NAME and AGENT_OPENCODE_PERMISSION_DENY, add ("bee-elder", &["advisor"]) and a bee-elder deny row equal to bee-scout's, and add `pub const RETIRED_AGENT_NAMES: &[(&str, &str)]` holding the five (old, new) pairs. In onboard/agents.rs make compute_agent_file_plan and compute_opencode_agent_file_plan also emit remove_agent_file / remove_opencode_agent_file for every retired path that exists (search `for tmpl_name in list_template_agents`), each item carrying `replacement: <new name>`; apply.rs already deletes such items (apply.rs:796-810) and needs no change — only make its printed line name the replacement when the item carries one. In verbs/drivers/guard.rs rename every ROLE_AGENTS row (the array type grows to 6), add ("advisor", "bee-elder") as the LAST row, rename agent_job_summary arms (add bee-elder: 'advises read-only from a fixed seat and reports (never writes, never decides)'), and rewrite the doc text that says bee renders no advisor agent. In verbs/drivers/prompt.rs rename the include_str! paths and match arms and add AGENT_ELDER. In verbs/drivers/prepare.rs add an `"advisor" => "bee-elder"` arm to the pinned_type match (search `"cell" if design_role =>`) so every --kind advisor dispatch on claude — bare advisor role AND seat roles such as hat-value or lane-2 — returns subagent_type bee-elder while the marker still names the RESOLVED role; add a test for each in drivers/tests.rs, and one asserting a herding-shaped advisor slot now prefixes the pane prompt with the elder body. In hooks/model_guard.rs: (1) extend the general-purpose repair so a prompt carrying `[bee-kind: advisor]` with a seat marker is repaired onto bee-elder; (2) in the bare-denied refusal, when subagent_type is a retired name, prepend one line 'subagent_type "bee-build" was renamed to "bee-worker"' from RETIRED_AGENT_NAMES; (3) deny a marker dispatch whose subagent_type is a retired name with that same rename line (reason `retired-agent-type`) instead of allowing it through to the host's own not-found error. Drop `advisor` from the loop in the existing test `a_role_with_no_rendered_agent_is_never_repaired_to_undefined` (it now has a rendered agent). Add tests: `[bee-tier: hat-value]` + bee-elder allowed; `[bee-tier: advisor]` + general-purpose repaired onto bee-elder; `[bee-tier: hat-value]` + general-purpose + `[bee-kind: advisor]` repaired onto bee-elder; bare `bee-build` denied with the rename line; `[bee-tier: code]` + `bee-build` denied retired-agent-type. In doctor.rs point DESIGN_AGENT_REL and its messages and tests at .claude/agents/bee-comb.md. In generated/registry_payload.json rename the bee-extract mention in the dispatch.prepare --role description (this file is hand-maintained, not regenerated). In verbs/reviews.rs change the test git email bee-review@example.com to bee-guard@example.com. Sweep every remaining old name in the listed files (tests, fixtures, FIX strings such as hook_local.rs 'dispatch a bee-extract worker'). Do NOT touch the bee-design skill or bee-design-* packs anywhere (skills.rs, doctor DESIGN_SKILL, design/). No code comments; rewrite the touched `//`/`///` lines that explain the tables so they name the new shells, never add new ones. Do not run bee dev regen or onboard --apply: the leader runs the regen chain once at wave close.

truths: bee dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind cell returns subagent_type bee-worker; --kind gather returns bee-forager; --kind gather --role extraction returns bee-scout; --kind reviewer returns bee-guard; a design-role cell returns bee-comb
bee dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind advisor returns subagent_type bee-elder, and --kind advisor --role hat-value also returns bee-elder with [bee-tier: hat-value]

The model guard allows subagent_type bee-elder under a seat marker, repairs general-purpose onto bee-elder under [bee-tier: advisor] and under a seat marker with [bee-kind: advisor], and denies a retired name (bare or under a marker) with a one-line rename hint
On a host that still holds .claude/agents/bee-build.md (or any retired name), bee onboard plans remove_agent_file for it with replacement named; same for .opencode/agent/
A herding-shaped advisor slot's pane prompt is prefixed with the bee-elder body
`rg -n 'bee-build|bee-gather|bee-extract|bee-review\b' packages/` returns nothing; bee-design remains only as the skill and pack names
The full cargo suite is green
